_about: Verdicts for the nightly course SLO and objectives read (step 11 of docs/reference/scheduled_sessions.md; Sam, 2026-11-01: "yes to SLO hints and the nightly harvest"). Each read collects a course's SLOs and its course objectives in one pass (Sam, 2026-11-13: "add objectives to the collection list of data from cors. they should be collected when slos are collected"); where an outline system prints no objectives is recorded in OBJECTIVES_BY_SYSTEM (kb/_course_outcomes_read.py), and the colleges read before the reader took them are reread in the order of objectives_reread_plan.json. scripts/next_slo_colleges.py skips a college listed here. state: none (its public pages print no course SLOs), held (waits on what why names), parser (its pages print SLOs the reader does not parse yet: a build item). Keyed by harvest slug; by names the session, on the date, source the run or PR that shows it. A session adds a row when a trial or a read shows it, and removes one when what it waited on changes (a new catalog year, a parser fix).
